context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements a JSON-processing handler with proper type imports, error handling via return values instead of throws, JSON artifact mimeType, and well-configured agent-card.json with tag metadata.

checklist.name: Default async handler export
checklist.description: Handler uses correct export default async function signature with proper types

checklist.name: requestParts access with safety
checklist.description: Accesses task.requestParts?.[0] with undefined checking before processing

checklist.name: JSON.stringify for artifact
checklist.description: Uses JSON.stringify() to serialize the artifact value (not returning a raw object)

checklist.name: Error as return not throw
checklist.description: Returns an error result object (e.g., { ok: false, error: 'message' }) instead of throwing on invalid input

checklist.name: reportStatus at stages
checklist.description: Uses ctx?.reportStatus() at multiple processing stages (e.g., 'Validating...', 'Transforming...')

checklist.name: Tag examples
checklist.description: agent-card.json tags array includes examples for the tag
